text: Rollo had come along in Gus’s coat pocket, uninvited. He found the paper wedged under a crate, and tried to eat it.
Old paper, salt-stained. Four ships for four years of life. Payable to the bearer.
Signed with an M. Witnessed in a thin, sloping hand: S. Crane.
Payable to the bearer. Whoever holds the paper is owed the ships.
And the bearer had just sailed into their harbour.
